{{Quote|Silver Fyre helms the biggest gang of star pirates and mercenaries in the business!"<br />"Some mercenaries aren't as bad as they'd like people to believe."<br />"And more are worse than they let on, your royalness!|Han Solo and Leia Organa|<ref name="TG" />}}
'''Silver Fyre''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who led the [[Aquaris Freeholders/Legends|Aquaris Freeholders]], said by some to be the largest gang of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Fyre built a large underwater base on the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]-covered [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Aquaris/Legends|Aquaris]], and after pledging her support to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in their battle against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], welcomed a group of Rebel leaders including [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] to Aquaris. After the Rebels helped Fyre uncover her second-in-command [[Kraaken]] as an Imperial asset, Fyre pledged the Freeholders to help the Rebels break the [[Yavin blockade]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I never said Silver Fyre didn't think big, your worship&mdash;just crooked!"<br />"When I met with her, she was every inch the proper diplomat!|Han Solo and Leia Organa Solo|<ref name="TG" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] criminal and rogue, Silver Fyre became the leader of a gang called the [[Aquaris Freeholders/Legends|Freeholders]] during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and built a dangerous reputation in underworld circles. Over the course of her criminal career, Fyre had several run-ins with [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], earning his ire after her Freeholders hijacked a shipment of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] Solo was delivering. Along the way, Fyre developed a reputation for treachery, and sold out a number of rivals to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TG" /> After building the Freeholders into one of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] largest [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] and smuggling gangs, Fyre began looking for a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to call their own. Although she considered more obvious choices such as [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]] and the [[Vergesso Asteroids/Legends|Vergesso Asteroids]], she ultimately settled on [[Aquaris/Legends|Aquaris]], an uninhabited, [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]-covered world<ref name="egpm">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

[[File:Silver_Fyre_and_Kraaken.png|thumb|left|200px|Silver Fyre along with her second-in-command, Kraaken.]]
Fyre sunk thousands of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] into constructing a state-of-the-art underwater base for her Freeholders, which could remain undetected by [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] but still could connect to the wider world through a mechanized landing pad that could be extended above the ocean's surface.<ref name="egpm" /> As the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] began to rage, however, Fyre found her interests being pulled away from crime. Having spent years attempting to evade Imperial law, Fyre became intrigued with what the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had to offer, and was convinced to join the Rebel fold after meeting major Rebel leader [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] at the [[Conference of Uncommitted Worlds]] on the planet [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]].<ref name="egpm" /> Organa&mdash;along with fellow Rebel leaders [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and Solo, Fyre's old smuggling acquaintance&mdash;visited Fyre on Aquaris soon afterward, looking for shelter and aid helping to break the [[Yavin blockade|Imperial blockade]] of the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]].<ref name="TG" />

Solo, still distrustful of Fyre from their past encounters, felt obligated to prove to Organa that Fyre was planning to betray them to the Imperials. Assuming that Fyre had their room bugged, he began to speak openly about secret information stored on their [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. Solo's instincts about being spied upon, incidentally, were correct&mdash;Fyre quickly received a report on everything from her second-in-command, [[Kraaken]]. Genuinely wanting to prove her loyalty to the Rebels, Fyre agreed to a plan formed by Kraaken to win Solo's trust: her, Kraaken and their Rebel guests would go out on a hunting party where the rest of the group would be threatened, before Fyre rushed to save the day in her [[aqua-skimmer]].<ref name="TG" />

Although Fyre elected not to go through with the plan, she and Solo had to make a rescue anyway, when Kraaken&mdash;who had Skywalker with him in his skimmer&mdash;went after a deadly [[demonsquid]]. Fyre and Solo rushed to save Solo, only to find that Kraaken wasn't there, having [[Stun/Legends|stunned]] Skywalker and fled the skimmer before it reached the demonsquid. Realizing that Kraaken was an Imperial traitor and had conspired to get them out of the way so he could go after the droids, Fyre and the Rebels rushed back to their base, arriving in time to save a pinned-down Organa and capture Kraaken. Grateful for their help exposing her [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant's]] treachery, Fyre committed the aid of her Freeholders to the fighting in the Yavin system.<ref name="TG" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|&hellip;Becoming respectable enough to join the Rebel Alliance hasn't made me abandon ''all'' the skills I developed as a space pirate!|Silver Fyre|<ref name="TG" />}}
An adept liar and skilled criminal, Silver Fyre was particularly practiced in blending in with her situation: she could appear as the perfect diplomat just as easily as she could the cutthroat gangster. However, by the era of the Galactic Civil War, Fyre had started to become fixated on higher ideals than just plunder&mdash;<ref name="TG" /> her interest in the Rebel Alliance was partially borne out of irritation of having to deal with Imperial scrutiny of her criminal activities,<ref name="egpm" /> even though she had worked with Imperials in the past. Always more ambitious and cunning than most common gangsters, Fyre was genuine in her support of the Rebel Alliance, but was willing to resort to deceitful tactics in proving her loyalty, and she still remained sharp in her skills despite going "respectable."<ref name="TG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Silver Fyre appeared in ''[[Traitor's Gambit]]'', a [[Star Wars (comic strip)|comic strip]] story arc written by [[Archie Goodwin]], illustrated by [[Al Williamson]] and released in [[1982]].<ref name="TG" />
